title: Secret Lair Drop Series: December Superdrop 2022
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Universes Beyond Secret Lair drops)

paragraphs.text: The December Superdrop 2022 is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It is available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from December 5, 2022 through January 6, 2023.
This Superdrop includes three drops connected to the Hasbro -owned Transformers franchise and adjacent to the Transformers set.

It also includes a drop in collaboration with the estate of noted comic book artist Frank Frazetta , using some of his iconic art for reprints. Coincidentally, earlier in 2022 that same art was also used for the Sorcery: Contested Realm TCG .

The drops can be bought separately or in several bundles. The Transformers Bundle contains all Transformers drops for $88.99 (non-foil) or $119.99 (foil). The Big-Non-Foil Bundle ($268.99) and Big-Non-Foil Bundle ($358.99) contain all other drops. The bundles of this superdrop don't provide a discount. Instead, an exclusive bonus card with art by Barely Human was made available for spending $200 on a purchase.

For this superdrop, an exclusive bonus card with art by Barely Human was made available for spending $200 on a purchase. This Secret Lair Promo The Scarab God is not available outside of this promotion.

As an extra, each drop comes with a surprise bonus card. Except for the cases listed below, the potential bonus cards for these drops included various extended art slivers, blueprint cards, and borderless versions of Shadowborn Apostle .
